note: x_search accepts at most 20 handles per allowed_x_handles call. Lanes are searched separately so each stays under the cap.

xLanes.label: NYC venture accounts
xLanes.query: New York City startup announcing a funding round, new NYC office, or NYC hiring push

xLanes.label: NYC tech press
xLanes.query: New York City company office expansion, headquarters move, new Manhattan office, or funding round

xLanes.label: Open founder chatter
xLanes.query: Founders and operators posting that their New York City team outgrew its office, is opening a NYC office, is moving offices, or is hiring a head of workplace

xLanes.label: NYC commercial real estate chatter
xLanes.query: Manhattan office lease signed, tenant seeking space, sublease listed, or NYC office market tenant demand

webLanes.label: NYC funding announcements
webLanes.query: New York City headquartered startup raised Series A, Series B, or Series C in the last 14 days

webLanes.label: NYC office moves and expansions
webLanes.query: company opening new New York City office OR relocating headquarters to Manhattan OR expanding NYC office space

webLanes.label: Workplace / office leadership hires
webLanes.query: company hired Head of Workplace OR Director of Workplace Experience OR Office Manager in New York City

webLanes.label: NYC hiring surges
webLanes.query: startup rapidly hiring in New York City, growing NYC team, dozens of open NYC roles
